definitions.explanation: The opening of flower buds; the act of flowers coming into bloom. Frequently used in weather reports about cherry blossom season.
Figuratively, the blossoming or realization of talent, effort, or potential.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開花|かいか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開花|かいか}⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧だ。
examples.english: The bloom forecast for this year is late March.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暖冬|だんとう}→暖冬：21745_dantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{開花|かいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}まっている→早まる：04585_hayamaru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the warm winter, flowering is earlier than usual.

⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}び→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧、⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開花|かいか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧だった。

examples.english: Studying abroad was the catalyst for her language ability to flourish.

notes:
Compound of {開|かい} (to open) + {花|か} (flower).

SENSE 1 (flowering):
The ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開花|かいか}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧ (cherry blossom bloom announcement) is an eagerly awaited event each spring. The Japan Meteorological Agency tracks {開花|かいか}⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧ (the bloom front) as it moves northward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 1):
- {開花|かいか}⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧ (bloom announcement)
- {開花|かいか}⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ (bloom forecast)
- {開花|かいか}⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧ (flowering season)

SENSE 2 (figurative):
Used for talent, ability, or potential reaching full expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 2):
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開花|かいか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (talent blossoms)
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開花|かいか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (ability blooms)
